##### Project General Facts

Lyvin Uluwatu is a premium boutique development by an internationally award-winning developer and hotel operator, renowned for top ratings on all major booking platforms. Located in Bali’s most touristic area, this striking complex features a collection of spacious apartments with soaring ceilings reaching up to five meters, a rare and highly desirable advantage. Every unit offers breathtaking panoramic ocean views, designed for both sophisticated living and profitable investment, backed by high standards of management and guest service.

Residents and guests enjoy an exceptional blend of public and private facilities. The complex features a sprawling swimming pool, a tranquil spa, a restaurant, a fully equipped gym, and a lush botanical garden. Underground parking and five-star hotel infrastructure complete the offering. The thoughtful layout allows guests to walk home after a massage or stroll to the restaurant for morning coffee without ever leaving the serene premises.

Every apartment at Lyvin Uluwatu is delivered fully furnished and ready to welcome guests. Tower A features integrated appliances, modern fittings, silent closing mechanisms, and sleek, uncluttered spaces. Tower B showcases upcycled materials, durable native Indonesian Ulin wood, and natural textures that calm the mind. From hand-selected furnishings to seamless storage and stunning ocean views, each residence is a masterpiece of sustainable luxury and impeccable craftsmanship. Shared parking is available for residents and guests.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on a lush green hilltop in Uluwatu within Badung regency, this exceptional location places residents in one of Bali’s most prestigious coastal districts and the island's most popular tourist area. The neighborhood offers panoramic ocean views, refreshing island breezes, and a serene atmosphere that attracts discerning travelers from around the world. Uluwatu is renowned for its dramatic cliffs, world-class surf breaks, and some of the island’s most iconic beach clubs, with one of the most popular surf beaches in the world just a two-minute walk away.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional convenience and vibrant lifestyle offerings. Just a short walk from the complex, visitors can access the area’s most popular beach clubs, countless restaurants, wellness spas, and fitness centers. The neighborhood is also home to a strong international community, premium boutiques, and cultural attractions that enhance daily life. Unlike more crowded areas, this location offers a peaceful retreat without sacrificing access to world-class amenities.

For those seeking a residence that embodies both tranquility and prestige, Uluwatu delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, limited development, soaring interiors, ocean views from every unit, and proximity to the island’s finest attractions makes it a top choice for discerning investors and homeowners. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, serene, sophisticated and effortlessly inspiring.
